title: Your Journey Through Darkwind
intro: A stage-by-stage walkthrough from your first steps to seasoned adventurer. Each stage is its own short help page -- read them as your character grows, not all at once.
guidance: At every stage: play at play.darkwind.ai for the live map and panels (help client), browse all topics with help list, and report anything odd with bug, idea, or typo.

stages.title: Your First Minutes
paragraphs: A short tutorial starts automatically for new characters and teaches looking, moving, gear, and safe combat. Darkflow shows it in a hover window. Type tutorial to see your current step and tutorial continue to continue in any client.

Learn to look at everything (look <thing>), check your inventory, and read your score. If you ever get lost, ncot returns you to the Center of Town, and the Newbie Tome Dispenser there (pull lever, read tome) holds the town directions.

Make the interface work for you before you roam. set list shows your saved options. Useful first choices are set autoexits on for named exits, set npcdetail on for NPC levels, and set itemdetail on for raw weapon and armour ratings. Use monitor bar for live HP/SP. If you use a screenreader, run set screenreader on to enable screenreader-friendly output.

stages.title: Gear Up and Learn to Fight
paragraphs: Erga's newbie store (from the Center of Town: 4w, s) hands out free equipment fit for anyone under level 5; the donation room (5n, e) has castoffs from generous veterans. Wear and wield everything, then practice on the newbie farm.
Death carries NO penalty at level 5 and under, so this is the time to take risks and learn kill, assess, and wimpy. Ask questions freely on the newbie channel -- everyone started here.
Choose your corpse automation: set autogold on takes coins only, while set autoloot on takes coins and every gettable item, making autogold redundant and filling your inventory faster.

set autokill on does not attack by itself; it only makes a manually entered bare kill choose the first visible NPC. Keep naming targets until you are comfortable. set wimpy 25 retreats below 25 percent HP when an escape is possible. set combatbrief-short on trims combat text; in busy groups, set combatbrief-self on keeps attacks by or on you, and set combatbrief-hit on hides misses and dodges.

stages.title: Choose Your Path
paragraphs: Once the farm feels easy, pick a guild -- it defines your abilities for the climb ahead. Browse the roster, the playstyle archetypes, and which pairings work before committing.
Level at the adventurers guild with advance; experience costs grow with each level, and your stats shape what your abilities can do.

You can handle normal advancement from anywhere. remcost is a safe, read-only report of stat costs, available raises, caps, and experience needed. Use remadvance <stat> to raise one stat or remadvance level to buy every level you can currently afford. Guild advancement still happens at your guild hall with advance guild. Despite their names, the rem commands work before remort.
Non-remort players may use set autolevel on to spend experience on levels automatically; leave it off when you want to bank experience for stat raises. Remort souls always level automatically.

stages.title: See the World
paragraphs: The world is far bigger than town. The areas command catalogs every region with level ranges; characters up to level 10 already know the newbie-area wayshards, so touch shard networks open fast travel as you explore. Pick up quests for structured goals and bonus experience.
Above level 5 death starts to cost 10% of your experience on hand -- your corpse keeps your gear, the church will whisk you back, and other players can avenge you to restore what you lost.

stages.title: Money and Craft
paragraphs: Coins pile up: open a bank account early -- auction bids and some purchases are backed by bank liens, and your balance is shared across every branch. rembank or rembank balance opens the account on first use and reports its balance, lien, and spendable amount.

From anywhere that is not warded against teleportation, rembank deposit all banks every carried coin and rembank withdraw <amount> brings coins back. Use rembank lien to check reserved funds. Use rembank transfer <amount|all> from <alt> to pull funds from one of your registered alts into the current character. Balance and lien checks still work in warded rooms.

Learn the player-driven economy: shops, the remote market, and the live auction channel. When you want a break from fighting, professions like fishing, mining, and smithing earn steadily and feed the market.

stages.title: Find Your People
paragraphs: Darkwind is social. Channels connect the whole game; parties share the fight and the spoils; clans are player-run organizations with wars and coffers; kingdoms crown player rulers with their own nobility.
Pick a divine patron when the gods start to notice you -- alignment and devotion open their own doors.

stages.title: Sharpen the Blade
paragraphs: Mid-game is about power and polish: track your buffs and debuffs, hunt boss monsters and invasions, brave the eternal dungeon, duel in the arena, and chase achievements, daily rewards, and leaderboard rank.
Unique weapons and armour -- one copy in the whole game -- are out there for the claiming.

stages.title: Renown and Rebirth
paragraphs: At level 100 your level becomes renown -- HERO, ADV, or VILN by your deeds. Level 150 makes you a LEGEND and unlocks a free additional multichar slot. New mythic multichar registration is disabled.

At 250 the true endgame opens: remort, a rebirth that trades your level for permanent boon points and starts the climb again, stronger each cycle. Specialization and the metaphysician path round out a veteran's power.
